$comment: Single source of the Partcraft engine message protocol. protocol/generate.mjs turns it into TypeScript (app/src/engine/generated/protocol.ts), C++ (engine/src/generated/protocol.hpp) and JSON Schema (protocol/engine-protocol.schema.json). Edit only this file, then run: node protocol/generate.mjs

protocol.name: partcraft-engine
protocol.doc: A message is a UTF-8 JSON header plus an optional binary payload. Commands go from the client to the engine and carry a client-chosen request id; every engine message that answers a command carries that id as replyTo. Desktop: the engine is a child process, both directions use length-prefixed frames on stdin/stdout. Browser: the engine is a WebAssembly module in a Web Worker; header and payload are passed as (string, ArrayBuffer | null).

constants.name: frameMagic
constants.doc: First four bytes of every stdio frame: 'P' 'C' 'E' '1' (frame format 1), read as a little-endian u32.

constants.name: framePrefixBytes
constants.doc: Frame prefix: u32 magic, u32 header bytes, u32 payload bytes, u32 reserved (0); all little-endian. Header and payload follow.

constants.name: payloadAlignment
constants.doc: Every buffer inside a payload starts at a multiple of this many bytes from the payload start.

constants.name: maxRequestId
constants.doc: Request ids are integers from 1 to this value (they must fit an Int32Array slot, used by the WebAssembly cancel flag).

constants.name: pingIntervalMs
constants.doc: Desktop supervisor: interval between pings to the native engine.

constants.name: pingTimeoutMs
constants.doc: Desktop supervisor: the native engine is stopped when a ping stays unanswered this long. The native engine answers pings while it computes.

constants.name: nativeExecutable
constants.doc: File name of the native engine without extension (.exe on Windows).

constants.name: wasmModuleFile
constants.doc: ES module that loads the WebAssembly engine; partcraft-engine.wasm must be served next to it.

constants.name: wasmModuleFactory
constants.doc: Default export of the ES module: async factory (moduleOverrides) -> module. Overrides used: onEngineMessage(header: string, payload: ArrayBuffer | null), optional cancelFlags (Int32Array, slot 0 = id of the command to cancel), print, printErr.

constants.name: wasmInitExport
constants.doc: Module function _pc_init(hasCancelFlags: 0 | 1): number. Creates the engine once and returns the protocol version.

constants.name: wasmHandleExport
constants.doc: Module function _pc_handle(headerPtr, headerBytes, payloadPtr, payloadBytes): void. Handles one message and runs everything it queued before returning; replies arrive synchronously through onEngineMessage. The caller allocates both buffers with _malloc and frees them with _free afterwards.

errors.doc: hello asked for a protocol version the engine does not speak; user interface and engine come from different builds.
A command arrived before a successful hello.
The header is not valid JSON, not an object, or a field is missing, has the wrong type or is out of range. The message names the field.
The command type is not known to this engine.
A test command (diagnostics.crash, diagnostics.hang) was sent to an engine built without test commands.
The command was cancelled before or while it ran.
Test only: diagnostics.crash did not end the engine on this platform.
An unexpected failure inside the engine; detail holds the raw exception text.

EngineInfo.doc: What the engine is and how it was built.

version.doc: Short product version of the build (first line of version.txt), e.g. v2026.11.4.

versionFull.doc: Full build version (second line of version.txt).

platform.doc: native = separate desktop process, wasm = WebAssembly module in a worker.

testCommands.doc: true when the engine was built with test commands (diagnostics.crash, diagnostics.hang).

PlanegcsInfo.doc: Source of the bundled planegcs sketch solver.

source.doc: Project and release the solver sources come from, e.g. FreeCAD 1.1.4.

commit.doc: Full git commit of those sources.

ComponentVersions.doc: Versions of the libraries compiled into the engine.

Capabilities.doc: What the transport of this engine can do.

pingWhileBusy.doc: ping and cancel are answered while a command runs (native: reader thread). The WebAssembly engine answers only between commands.

cancelWhileBusy.doc: cancel reaches a running command (native always; WebAssembly only with a shared cancel flag).

KernelSelftestStep.doc: One modelling operation of the kernel self-test with its validity and plausibility check.

valid.doc: BRepCheck_Analyzer reports the result as valid.

volume.doc: Volume of the result in mm^3.

expectedVolume.doc: Volume computed by hand (closed form) in mm^3.

problem.doc: Why the step failed; missing when it passed.

hello.doc: First command of every connection. Compares the protocol version; every other command is refused before it.

client.doc: Free text naming the client and its version, for diagnostics.

ping.doc: Liveness check. The native engine answers while it computes; the WebAssembly engine only between commands.

cancel.doc: Cancels a queued or running command. The cancelled command answers with error code cancelled.

target.doc: Id of the command to cancel.

shutdown.doc: Runs after the commands queued before it, answers bye; the native engine then exits with code 0.

diagnostics.kernelSelftest.doc: Builds a block 80 x 50 x 20 mm with a through hole of 20 mm and a 3 mm fillet on the top hole edge, and checks every operation with BRepCheck_Analyzer plus volume and face count against closed-form values.

diagnostics.solverSelftest.doc: Solves a fixed, fully constrained sketch (rectangle 60 x 40 mm with a tangent arc of diameter 20 mm and a line angle) with planegcs DogLeg and verifies the result with independent geometry checks.

diagnostics.crash.doc: Test only: ends the engine on purpose (native: the process dies; WebAssembly: a trap). Used to test the desktop supervisor and the worker restart.

mode.doc: abort = std::abort, nullcall = call through a null function pointer, intdiv = integer division by zero.

diagnostics.hang.doc: Test only. busy: the command computes for ms milliseconds (or until cancelled when ms is missing) and answers hangResult; ping is still answered natively. frozen: the engine stops answering anything, including ping, until it is killed (desktop supervisor and browser watchdog tests).

ms.doc: busy only: duration; missing = until cancelled.

busyWith.doc: Id of the running command, null when idle.

cancelResult.doc: Answer to cancel. The cancelled command itself answers with error code cancelled.

state.doc: Where the target was: still queued, running, or neither (already answered or unknown).

kernelSelftestResult.doc: Answer to diagnostics.kernelSelftest. A failed check is a normal answer with passed = false.

problem.doc: First failure in plain words; missing when passed.

volume.doc: Volume of the final body in mm^3 (0 when no body was built).

timeMs.doc: Time of all operations and checks.

solverSelftestResult.doc: Answer to diagnostics.solverSelftest. A failed check is a normal answer with passed = false.

problem.doc: First failure in plain words; missing when passed.

dof.doc: Remaining degrees of freedom reported by planegcs.

maxResidual.doc: Largest constraint residual, computed independently of planegcs from the solved geometry (mm or rad).

maxDeviation.doc: Largest distance of a solved point or radius from its closed-form value (mm).

reference.doc: Reference dimensions measured after solving (never given to the solver), by constraint id.

hangResult.doc: Answer to diagnostics.hang in busy mode.

ms.doc: How long the command actually ran.

error.doc: Failure of a command, or of a message that could not be read (then replyTo is null).

message.doc: Complete, specific cause written by the engine.

detail.doc: Raw technical text (exception type and text), when there is one.

command.doc: Type of the failed command, when known.
